headline: NZX 50 slides as Chinese AI competition fears knock Asian markets
summary: New Zealand's NZX 50 joined an Asian selloff after reports that ChangXin Memory Technologies was catching rivals, knocking Kospi and triggering a circuit-breaker pause.
why: The Kospi is heavily weighted toward SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics, major memory chipmakers whose outlook drives global chip stocks.
